description:
About AlphaSense: 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Team:

Our Customer Success team is made up of Account Directors  and Customer Success Managers who are passionate about helping our clients succeed. We partner with a diverse range of organizations, from Fortune 1000 companies to some of the largest financial institutions globally.

As a team, we are committed to providing value to our clients. We take a consultative approach to solve challenges through our product, ensuring our customers have the right data to make informed decisions. We focus on retaining customers, maximizing product usage, and collaborating with the sales team to uncover growth opportunities.

About the Role: 

We’re looking for a high-impact Account Director to own and expand relationships with our most complex and high-value accounts within the Corporate Life Sciences sector. You'll be the primary point of contact for a book of Fortune 1000 accounts—driving renewals, adoption, and growth. In this role, you'll be expected to collaborate with account executives, identifying new business opportunities to help expand our footprint within each client account.

While key performance indicators include retention rate and the identification of growth opportunities, the responsibilities of Account Directors go much deeper. The team also extracts a wealth of knowledge from our clients, bringing that internally to product, marketing and sales teams in order to maximize the effectiveness of our business' strategy and communication.

What You’ll Do: 

  • Forecast and maximize retention rate across your book of business
  • Increase and drive adoption of AlphaSense solutions into other business units of existing clients to uncover new opportunities, exceeding monthly, quarterly and annual revenue goals
  • Identify revenue at risk in order to best position the company to prevent churn
  • Collaborate with Account Executives to identify growth opportunities within the book of business
  • Understand the ins and outs of the business, roles, responsibilities, projects, performance metrics, etc. within our client base in order to more effectively: 1) communicate with users, 2) communicate with decision makers, 3) identify white space, 4) partner with AE to craft most compelling messaging to prospective users
  • Cultivate relationships with users and key stakeholders to ensure AlphaSense is viewed as a business partner rather than vendor
  • Hold Business Reviews with key stakeholders
  • Consistent proactive outreach with material and information that’s relevant for our user base
  • Serve as our boots on the ground and physical presence within each client (floor walks, lunch and learns, etc.)
  • Serve as both the advocate for AlphaSense to the client, and the client advocate within AlphaSense
  • Acquire value stories and product feedback from clients. Circulate internally to assist with product development, marketing, sales efforts

Who You Are:

  • Relationship-driven: You have a strong ability to develop instant rapport with new people and you’ve demonstrated success at managing and growing relationships within Fortune 1000 clients
  • A subject matter expert: You excel at what you do and know how to succeed within your role -- this includes both internal and external relationship management as well as strong business acumen and commitment to effective processes and tactics
  • Knowledgeable and experienced in Life Sciences: Experience working with clients in the Life Sciences industry, including Pharma, Biotech, Medical devices and diagnostics - additional bonus for familiarity with competitive intelligence, business development and clinical and commercial strategy workflows.
  • Energetic and creative: You possess a natural intellectual curiosity with the ability to learn and adapt quickly
  • You understand our business: We are a rapidly growing SaaS company and are incredibly passionate about our product. We are looking for individuals who understand best practices for client engagement within a SaaS environment;
  • Committed to delivering results: You set the example for grit, work ethic, initiative, enthusiasm and commitment amongst your peers.
  • A strong communicator: You’ll regularly be engaged with day-to-day users to C-level executives and that requires exceptional oral, written and presentation skills. You’ll need to distill and explain complex issues in simple terms.

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

You will present to the board. You will be in the room for every capital allocation decision. There is no team. There is no process to maintain. description:
Do you follow every shift in digital marketing, media and commerce, and always have a view on which stories matter the most?

Do you want to create content across channels that educates the next generation of marketers?

Does the idea of shaping the content for one of digital marketing's longest-running publications excite you?

If so, we'd love to hear from you!

About us

Fospha is the measurement system enterprise retail and ecommerce brands run their business on. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what's actually working — across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop — down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on. Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, and Lululemon use Fospha up to 25 times a day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform — and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin.

About ClickZ

ClickZ is Fospha's media partner and one of the world's longest-running digital marketing publications, trusted by CMOs and senior marketers since 1997. Its focus is how measurement shapes marketing decisions, and it covers the wider marketing that measurement informs. Readers come to ClickZ to understand:

  • How marketing leaders build teams, explain results to finance and earn influence in the room
  • Retail and commerce marketing, including retail media and marketplaces
  • How AI, search and ad platform changes affect planning and results
  • Where to invest across brand, creative, performance, affiliate and influencer marketing
  • How brands measure performance, from attribution and incrementality to mix modelling

 

The Role

This is a permanent role at the heart of ClickZ. You'll run the day-to-day content engine: spotting the stories that matter to marketing leaders, turning them into sharp content across email, social and the website, and growing the audience that reads it.

The work is varied. In a single week you might cover a session at a major commerce event, publish a piece on a platform change, prepare a leadership Q&A, and review a stack of contributor pitches. You'll also build ClickZ's network of event partners, contributors, PR contacts and industry leaders, and meet many of them in person at industry events.

You'll work closely with ClickZ's lead, who sets the brand's strategy, and you'll have real ownership of your workstreams from the start. This is an office-based role in London.

This role suits someone with a journalist's instinct for a story, a marketer's eye for an audience, and the energy to keep both going every week.

 

What you'll work on

Your time will be spread across three areas, with content creation at the core. All three serve one goal: growing the ClickZ brand and getting its content to more of the right people.

Focus area What it covers
Content creation The core of the role: editorial content on market trends, event coverage, brand leadership interviews and Q&As, flagship newsletters, and social content
Audience growth and content analysis Growing ClickZ's readership and subscribers, testing new formats, and using performance data to decide what to create next
Network and community Building relationships with event partners, marketing and commerce leaders, PR teams and contributors, online and in person at industry events

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Keep the content engine fed. Track the news and trends that matter to marketing and commerce leaders, and turn them into timely, well-argued content.
  • Raise the bar on every channel. Bring a creative eye to email, social and web content, and build a distinct content plan for each channel.
  • Shape the flagship newsletters. Draft and refine ClickZ's flagship newsletters, and develop more tailored formats for different parts of the audience.
  • Bring leadership conversations to life. Prepare and support podcast and Q&A conversations with leaders across marketing and commerce, and, with training and support, grow into hosting them.
  • Grow the audience. Work out which formats and topics readers respond to, and turn readers into subscribers. Design campaigns that bring back readers who've gone quiet.
  • Let data inform the calls. Track what content delivers, use the numbers to decide what to do next, and share what's working.
  • Be the first filter. Review PR pitches and contributor submissions, and pick out the strong and relevant ones.
  • Build the network. Reach out to contributors, speakers and event partners, grow an always-on contributor community, and build lasting relationships with PR teams and industry leaders.
  • Get out into the industry. Attend events, support event partnerships, and find new events worth ClickZ's time.
  • Work agentically. Use AI tools to speed up research, drafting and multimedia content, while owning the quality of what goes out.

 

What are we looking for?

We hire for potential and taste. You should apply if you meet these six must-haves:

  • Have around one year of experience creating content in the digital marketing, media or commerce world, whether in journalism, editorial, content or social roles (internships, placements and personal projects count), and a genuine passion for digital marketing and commerce, and for the leaders shaping them
  • Have strong editorial judgement: you can tell good content from weak, and relevant from noise, and you know a big story when you see one (experience of writing, editing or curating, including student or personal publications)
  • Bring a creative eye to content across email, social and web, with a feel for multimedia formats
  • Are audience-minded: you think about who's reading, how to reach more of the right people and how to build a community around a brand. You're also comfortable with data: you use performance numbers to make content decisions and back up your conclusions (experience using analytics such as GA4)
  • Are agentically minded: you love experimenting with new tools for multimedia content creation and adaptation, and know when to push them and when to take over
  • Are a natural conversationalist: you get a guest talking, hold your own with senior leaders, and leave an event with new connections

Also important:

  • Have high agency: you take ownership of your work, stretch beyond the brief and challenge the status quo when something could be better
  • Enjoy a fast-paced, innovative startup environment, where you'll ship quickly, iterate often and juggle several projects at once
  • Are happy to travel for industry events, within the UK and occasionally overseas

 

Our Values and Principles

You will be able to demonstrate examples of our core principles:

  • Seek inclusion & diversity: We create an environment where everyone feels welcome, and people are encouraged to speak and be heard
  • Work Hard, Work Well, Work Together: We take responsibility for making things happen, independently and together; we help colleagues in need and close loops, making sure our work is complete and has lasting impact
  • Grow: We are proactive, curious and unafraid of failure
  • Customer at the heart: We care about the customer, feel their pain and love building product that solves their biggest problems
  • Candour with caring: We deliver candid feedback with kindness and receive it with gratitude

 

What we can offer you

  • Salary: £34k + discretionary 10% bonus
  • Ownership of content for a media brand that has covered digital marketing for nearly 30 years
  • Early ownership of your workstreams, and the chance to shape how modern marketers learn and make decisions
  • A growing network across PR teams, contributors and industry leaders
  • Hands-on podcast experience, with regular conversations with leaders across marketing and commerce
  • A place at major industry events, with a front-row view of commerce, media and digital marketing
  • Be part of a leading global venture builder, Blenheim Chalcot, and learn from the incredible talent in BC
  • The right mix of challenges, learning and development opportunities
  • A workplace pension, through Royal London, with Fospha matching your contributions up to 3%
  • A £1,000/year flexible benefits allowance to put towards private medical insurance, dental cover, a health cash plan, gym membership, extra holiday, or a pension top-up - whatever suits you!
  • Access to Wellhub, giving you one membership across gyms, boutique studios, and wellbeing apps
  • 25 days' annual leave plus 8 UK bank holidays, an extra day off for your birthday! and more holiday the longer you stay (26 days after 3 years, 27 after 6)
  • Life assurance worth 4x your annual salary, from day one
  • Cycle to Work scheme, plus discounts on everyday spending through our benefits portal — Apple, Tesco, IKEA, M&S, Deliveroo, cinema tickets and more
  • Quarterly one-to-one sessions with a financial adviser, plus access to payroll-deducted loans through Salary Finance
  • Paid volunteering days each year
  • Regular socials, free weekly snacks, and Lunch & Learn events at our Scale Space office, plus access to the wider Blenheim Chalcot community
  • Opportunities to travel — including to our India and North America offices

Top tip: Share two or three pieces of content you're proud of, and tell us one story ClickZ should cover next, and why.

description:
ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD

NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We're the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.

We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.

THE ROLE: Data Analyst

NexGen Cloud is moving to a data-driven way of running the business. Right now, revenue, occupancy, billing and pipeline data live across data warehouses, business systems and APIs, and the numbers don't always agree. We're building out our Strategic Finance team so that leadership, sales and operations can rely on one set of figures and act on them daily.

This role suits someone who enjoys the technical craft of data and wants to learn the commercial side of the AI compute market. We'll teach you that context. When a number looks wrong, you'll dig until you find why, and you'll come back with a fix as well as the problem.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Rather than a checklist, here's what success in this role actually looks like:

  • Build and maintain the pipelines that bring data from across the business into Databricks and Power BI, and automate the manual steps along the way
  • Own the daily revenue and occupancy reporting that leadership uses to track how the GPU fleet is performing
  • Check that what we bill matches what customers actually used, covering power draw, utilisation, asset registers and credits
  • Support commission calculations and give sales leadership a clear view of pipeline health, conversion and churn
  • Model pricing options and deal economics so investment decisions are grounded in real numbers
  • Validate every figure before it reaches leadership or anyone outside the company
  • Help the wider team work confidently with BI tools and data

ABOUT YOU

We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You'll likely bring a combination of the following:

Essential:

  • Hands-on experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar role, including data extraction, integration or automation projects
  • Strong SQL and Excel skills
  • Solid Power BI experience, including reconciling figures when different sources disagree
  • Hands-on use of a CRM (HubSpot or similar), and of AI tools to speed up analysis and build work
  • A root-cause mindset: you find the underlying cause rather than reporting the symptom, and you bring a proposed solution with it

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Databricks
  • Exposure to billing, revenue assurance or commission processes, ideally in a cloud, SaaS or usage-based business
  • Some experience with financial modelling or FP&A work
  • Time spent in a high-growth company where data processes were still being built

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme
  • Employee wellbeing benefits
  • 25 days holiday, plus public holidays
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Enhanced Pension Scheme
  • Flexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)
  • Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment
  • Visible, meaningful impact as we scale
  • Clear career progression in a high-growth company
  • A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership
  • The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud's team, culture, and future

WHY APPLY

We welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems and want to build something meaningful at scale, we'd like to hear from you.

MORE INFORMATION

Visit our careers page to learn more about us or follow us on LinkedIn and X to learn more about our journey and keep up with our latest news and releases.

description: At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here. France is one of the most important flexibility markets in Europe. This role is critical to accelerating Axle’s growth in France. About the role Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach in France. At the core of our market expansion plans is market analysis. To maximise future revenue, we spend a lot of time understanding the value of flexibility in power markets around the world. We are looking for a technical individual (data scientist, analyst or engineer) with strong knowledge of the French electricity markets and an instinct for commercial value. You will become Axle’s internal expert on French power markets: understanding the market rules, modelling the value, and building relationships with system operators and regulators. We’re scrappy about method and rigorous about conclusions. You will speak fluent French and English. Other European languages will also be an asset. What you will be doing Developing a deep understanding of French energy markets and grid dynamics to understand how trading, compensation, penalties and cash flow work Jumping on the phone with grid operators, regulators and market stakeholders to validate hypotheses and make sense of data Building and optimising models of wholesale/NEBCO, capacity, balancing, ancillary services and local flexibility markets in France to forecast what different assets can earn Sizing the revenue opportunity across markets and products to shape where we expand next Building and evaluating different strategies for cycling a battery or load-shifting an EV charger Monitoring and shaping energy regulation to accelerate the growth of flexibility. This is an opportunity to gain unique domain expertise and build the quantitative case for first-of-a-kind projects across the world. What we think you need to be successful Deep quantitative and modelling ability (Python, SQL) Exceptional communication and the ability to turn data into actionable commercial insights Comfort moving fast and making decisions in an evolving environment Deep knowledge of French electricity markets (NEBCO, Mécanisme de Capacité, Mécanisme d’Ajustement, ancillary services…) Relationships with regulators, grid operators and other stakeholders (CRE, DGEC, RTE, Enedis, etc.) are a plus What’s in it for you This is a 12 month fixed-term contract (CDD). Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience. We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation. Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose. You’ll be based in France. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office. The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world. We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’. description:
Decathlon Digital recherche un·e Engineering Manager (f/m/d) en CDI basé·e à Lille ou Paris ! 

Chez Decathlon Digital, nous mettons la technologie au service du sport avec une ambition claire : impacter positivement 2 milliards de personnes d’ici 2035 tout en préservant notre terrain de jeu commun. Rejoindre nos équipes, c’est concevoir et opérer un écosystème numérique à très haute volumétrie (e-commerce, data, IA, cloud) qui connecte plus de 1900 magasins dans 54 pays. Pour soutenir cette accélération - marquée par le déploiement de l'IA et l'essor de nos modèles circulaires - nous recherchons un·e Engineering Manager engagé·e, capable de fédérer et de faire grandir nos talents techniques tout en relevant des défis d'architecture et de scalabilité à l'échelle mondiale.
 

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

En tant qu'Engineering Manager, tu accompagnes et guides une équipe pluridisciplinaire composée de développeur·euses, quality engineers et support engineers. Tu incarnes la culture tech de Decathlon Digital et joues un rôle clé à l'intersection de l'humain, de la technologie et du produit afin de créer un environnement sain et stimulant où ton équipe peut innover et livrer de la valeur durablement.
 
Management et Développement Humain
  • Recrutement et intégration : Recruter les futurs talents de l'équipe et garantir une expérience d'onboarding de qualité.
  • Animation par le sens et la confiance : Incarner le modèle managérial de Decathlon en donnant le cap, en responsabilisant les ingénieur·es (internes et externes) et en favorisant l'autonomie dans la prise de décision (principe de subsidiarité).
  • Accompagnement de proximité : Être le premier soutien de ton équipe via des points réguliers (1-on-1s), pratiquer l'écoute active et co-construire les parcours de développement de tes coéquipier·ères.
  • Culture de l'apprentissage : Créer un environnement psychologiquement sûr où l'on expérimente et où l'on apprend collectivement de chaque retour d'expérience.
Delivery et Excellence Opérationnelle
  • Pilotage de la livraison : Garantir une livraison fluide et prédictible des produits en collaboration étroite avec le·la Product Manager (PM).
  • Fiabilité et performance : Piloter les indicateurs de santé des applications grâce aux pratiques de Site Reliability Engineering (SRE).
  • Facilitation : Identifier, anticiper et lever les obstacles afin de fluidifier le quotidien des équipes d'ingénierie.
Vision Technique et Qualité
  • Architecture et conseil : Sans coder au quotidien, comprendre les enjeux techniques complexes et challenger constructivement les choix d'architecture avec les Tech Leads et Staff Engineers.
  • Culture qualité : Promouvoir les bonnes pratiques de Software Craftsmanship (tests automatisés, CI/CD, sécurité, performance, clean code).
  • Alignement stratégique : Aligner la roadmap technique de l'équipe avec la stratégie globale et les standards de Decathlon Digital.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Expérience : Tu possèdes une solide expérience en ingénierie logicielle ainsi qu'au moinds d'une prémière expérience réussie en management d'équipes techniques.
  • Leadership : Tu adoptes une posture de Servant Leader (leadership au service du collectif), faisant preuve d'empathie, d'écoute active et de capacité à fédérer autour d'objectifs communs.
  • Approche produit et agilité : Tu es orienté·e solution, produit et utilisateur·rice, avec une solide maîtrise des méthodes agiles au sein d'environnements complexes et internationaux.
  • Communication : Tu sais vulgariser des sujets techniques complexes et communiquer efficacement aussi bien avec des profils techniques qu'avec des parties prenantes métier (Product, Business).
  • Langues : La maîtrise de l'anglais professionnel est indispensable pour évoluer dans un contexte international.
  • Valeurs : Tu partages nos valeurs (vitalité, responsabilité, générosité, authenticité) et adhères à l'esprit du sport - collectif, dépassement de soi et bien-être - quel que soit ton niveau de pratique.

Environnement Technique & Pratiques :
  • Cloud, Architectures distribuées haute volumétrie, CI/CD, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Software Craftsmanship, Data & IA

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Organisation de travail hybride ;
  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;
  • Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;
  • Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;
  • Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITÉ

Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de toutes capacités à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es.

Decathlon s'engage également à offrir un processus de sélection inclusif et accessible à tous les candidat·es. En cas de besoin d'aménagement, tu peux en faire la demande via le formulaire de candidature, celle-ci sera confidentielle. Ces demandes n'affectent pas le résultat du processus de recrutement.

 

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.

The work is varied. In a single week you might cover a session at a major commerce event, publish a piece on a platform change, prepare a leadership Q&A, and review a stack of contributor pitches. You'll also build ClickZ's network of event partners, contributors, PR contacts and industry leaders, and meet many of them in person at industry events.

You'll work closely with ClickZ's lead, who sets the brand's strategy, and you'll have real ownership of your workstreams from the start. This is an office-based role in London.

This role suits someone with a journalist's instinct for a story, a marketer's eye for an audience, and the energy to keep both going every week.

 

What you'll work on

Your time will be spread across three areas, with content creation at the core. All three serve one goal: growing the ClickZ brand and getting its content to more of the right people.

Focus area What it covers
Content creation The core of the role: editorial content on market trends, event coverage, brand leadership interviews and Q&As, flagship newsletters, and social content
Audience growth and content analysis Growing ClickZ's readership and subscribers, testing new formats, and using performance data to decide what to create next
Network and community Building relationships with event partners, marketing and commerce leaders, PR teams and contributors, online and in person at industry events

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Keep the content engine fed. Track the news and trends that matter to marketing and commerce leaders, and turn them into timely, well-argued content.
  • Raise the bar on every channel. Bring a creative eye to email, social and web content, and build a distinct content plan for each channel.
  • Shape the flagship newsletters. Draft and refine ClickZ's flagship newsletters, and develop more tailored formats for different parts of the audience.
  • Bring leadership conversations to life. Prepare and support podcast and Q&A conversations with leaders across marketing and commerce, and, with training and support, grow into hosting them.
  • Grow the audience. Work out which formats and topics readers respond to, and turn readers into subscribers. Design campaigns that bring back readers who've gone quiet.
  • Let data inform the calls. Track what content delivers, use the numbers to decide what to do next, and share what's working.
  • Be the first filter. Review PR pitches and contributor submissions, and pick out the strong and relevant ones.
  • Build the network. Reach out to contributors, speakers and event partners, grow an always-on contributor community, and build lasting relationships with PR teams and industry leaders.
  • Get out into the industry. Attend events, support event partnerships, and find new events worth ClickZ's time.
  • Work agentically. Use AI tools to speed up research, drafting and multimedia content, while owning the quality of what goes out.

 

What are we looking for?

We hire for potential and taste. You should apply if you meet these six must-haves:

  • Have around one year of experience creating content in the digital marketing, media or commerce world, whether in journalism, editorial, content or social roles (internships, placements and personal projects count), and a genuine passion for digital marketing and commerce, and for the leaders shaping them
  • Have strong editorial judgement: you can tell good content from weak, and relevant from noise, and you know a big story when you see one (experience of writing, editing or curating, including student or personal publications)
  • Bring a creative eye to content across email, social and web, with a feel for multimedia formats
  • Are audience-minded: you think about who's reading, how to reach more of the right people and how to build a community around a brand. You're also comfortable with data: you use performance numbers to make content decisions and back up your conclusions (experience using analytics such as GA4)
  • Are agentically minded: you love experimenting with new tools for multimedia content creation and adaptation, and know when to push them and when to take over
  • Are a natural conversationalist: you get a guest talking, hold your own with senior leaders, and leave an event with new connections

Also important:

  • Have high agency: you take ownership of your work, stretch beyond the brief and challenge the status quo when something could be better
  • Enjoy a fast-paced, innovative startup environment, where you'll ship quickly, iterate often and juggle several projects at once
  • Are happy to travel for industry events, within the UK and occasionally overseas

 

Our Values and Principles

You will be able to demonstrate examples of our core principles:

  • Seek inclusion & diversity: We create an environment where everyone feels welcome, and people are encouraged to speak and be heard
  • Work Hard, Work Well, Work Together: We take responsibility for making things happen, independently and together; we help colleagues in need and close loops, making sure our work is complete and has lasting impact
  • Grow: We are proactive, curious and unafraid of failure
  • Customer at the heart: We care about the customer, feel their pain and love building product that solves their biggest problems
  • Candour with caring: We deliver candid feedback with kindness and receive it with gratitude

description:
About THG Ingenuity 

THG Ingenuity is a proprietary Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) technology, robotics, and operations platform built for global ecommerce. Developed through more than two decades of operating ecommerce and retail services at scale, its software and automation capabilities have been engineered, tested, and refined through the real-world demands of managing complex commerce operations. Today, THG Ingenuity provides an integrating operating environment that enables brands to intelligently optimise the entire commerce lifecycle from browsing and checkout to AI inventory management and forecasting, automated fulfilment, carrier control, and customer experience. The platform comprises: 

  • THG Fulfil: The fulfilment operating system for global ecommerce. Delivered via a proprietary SaaS and Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model, THG Fulfil orchestrates every stage of checkout, fulfilment, delivery, and customer experience through an integrated system. 
  • THG Studios: The UK's most innovative creative hub, helping brands create content that connects, experiences that engage, and IP that scales, all from its end-to-end, in-house facilities.  
  • THG Commerce: A cloud-native technology stack enabling retailers and brands to create intelligent, AI-powered, digital shopping experiences, while integrated marketplace and social commerce functionality allows brands to reach customers across every sales channel 

With its expertise in building and scaling brands, THG Ingenuity is uniquely positioned to bring pertinent, pragmatic, and global know-how across all aspects of commerce. 

Who are we?

Hale Country Club & Spa is a private members’ destination dedicated to elevated wellbeing. Designed for those who value performance as much as restoration, it offers an environment where fitness, luxury and community coexist. 

From a premium gym floor and boutique spin studio to paddle courts, spa facilities and tranquil wellness spaces, every element supports a balanced lifestyle. Members and guests enjoy chef-led, nutritionally considered menus within vibrant social spaces as a space to reset and feel your very best. Find out more about Hale Country Club here. 

The Role: 

We are looking for an energetic, passionate, and member-focused Gym Instructor to join the fitness team at Hale Country Club & Spa.

As a key part of our wellness offering, you will play an inspiring role in supporting members throughout their fitness journey, delivering exceptional service, expert guidance, and a motivating club experience.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and support members through our structured 4-week member journey, helping them build confidence, consistency, and results
  • Motivate, coach, and energise members during gym sessions and fitness activities
  • Deliver outstanding member experiences by providing ongoing support, encouragement, and fitness expertise
  • Build strong relationships with members and help grow and maintain class attendance to support engagement and retention
  • Deliver personalised Club Inductions to groups of up to 4 members, ensuring a welcoming and informative onboarding experience
  • Maintain a visible and proactive presence on the gym floor, offering guidance on exercise programmes and safe, effective equipment use
  • Oversee daily Gym Floor Operations, including equipment checks, studio preparation, cleanliness standards, maintenance reporting, and health & safety compliance
  • Professionally handle member enquiries, concerns, and feedback when required

About You:

  • Minimum Level 2 Fitness Instructor qualification (Level 3 Personal Trainer desirable)
  • Previous experience as a Gym Instructor and/or Personal Trainer within a health club, gym, or fitness environment
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills
  • Confident in prescribing and delivering tailored exercise programmes to both new and existing members
  • Passionate about health, fitness, and delivering exceptional member experiences
  • Evidence of continued professional development within the fitness industry
  • Organised, adaptable, and flexible with the ability to work a rota-based schedule

What We Offer:

  • The opportunity to work within a premium health, fitness, and wellness environment
  • Ongoing training and development opportunities
  • Opportunity to complete a Level 3 Personal Trainer Qualification (where applicable)
  • Supportive team culture with opportunities for growth and progression

THG Ingenuity is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.

THG Ingenuity is committed to creating a diverse & inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.

We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG Ingenuity please contact one of our Talent team to discuss further.

description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

 

What you’ll do at Jamf:

 

The Inside Account Executive is a key member of the EMEIA sales team, helping existing customers and channel partners understand how they can make the management and the security of their Apple devices robust and easy. The role works with the extended sales team to hit individual targets as well as contributing to the overall MEA sales goals.

 

This role is offered as hybrid, with the expectation to be in the office in Amsterdam Zuid 3 days per week. We are only able to accept applications for those based in the NL and have sponsorship to live and work in the NL #LI-Hybrid

 

What you can expect to do this role:

 

  • Communicate regularly with a defined list of existing accounts throughout the year to identify areas of need for business growth and new solutions
  • Own on-time renewal for your entire SMB customer portfolio; consistently meet or exceed retention rate targets.
  • Proactively engage customers 90–120 days ahead of renewal to understand health, flag risks, and secure commitment
  • Understand customer business needs and schedule technical demonstrations or face to face meetings with SE as required.
  • Identify and qualify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within the existing customer base by aligning Jamf solutions to customer business needs and industry insights.
  • Execute campaigns to drive traffic to online and in-person events
  • Enter new Opportunities and related information into SalesForce.com to document and manage sales activities
  • Develop well-rounded understanding of JAMF sales philosophy, market and customers
  • Know how to position JAMF Software solutions against competitor offerings
  • Accurately process customer transactions such as price quotations and purchase orders
  • Grow understanding of and ability to explain business value of JAMF Software solutions to prospects and existing customers
  • Responsible for leading and closing sales opportunities for the Strategic Commercial team
  • Performs all job responsibilities in alignment with the core values, mission and purpose of the organization
  • Adheres to the highest moral, ethical and legal standards to deliver an environment that promotes respect, innovation and creativity
  • Supports and promotes a positive, inclusive workplace one in which the talents and strengths of our increasingly diverse workforce are welcomed, further developed and manifested in our work

 

What we are looking for:

 

  • Professional working proficiency in English is required and Arabic is preferred but not required.
  • Minimum of 2+ years of experience in a sales, business or entrepreneurial role (required).
  • General Experience selling in both direct and indirect (channel) models (Preferred)
  • General Experience navigating and negotiating legal agreements (Required)
  • General Experience in software sales within high-growth technology companies (Preferred)
  • Ability to work independently and coordinate well with other team members that are remote
  • Ability to interact effectively with prospects and customers via phone and email
  • Ability to balance areas of responsibility across multiple territories
  • 10% travelling expected

 

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

 

  • Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory.
  • Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches.
  • Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.

 

Why Jamf?

 

  • Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News.
  • Named a 2025 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Gen Z
  • Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024
  • Named a 2024 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Parents & Families
  • Named a 2024 PEOPLE Companies That Care by PEOPLE® and Great Place To Work®
  • We offer a clear and defined sales career path. Our main goal is to help you successfully step into our Account Executive role, but there are many ways to advance your career at Jamf.
  • We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities.
  • You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class sales focused Bootcamp training provides you with the technical and product knowledge required to confidently talk with customers about Jamf.
  • We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.
  • You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 75,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.

What it means to be a Jamf?
We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.  

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.  

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement. 


What does Jamf do?
Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

Get social with us and follow the conversation at #OneJamf

description: About the role Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality. At SkyNRG, IT plays an important role in enabling a fast-growing organization to scale efficiently and securely. As an IT Operations Intern, you will support the daily running of our IT environment while contributing to projects that improve how the business operates. During this internship, you will gain hands-on experience with user lifecycle management, first-line support, and modern cloud-based IT environments. In addition to operations, you will contribute to automation and cybersecurity initiatives that help shape the future of IT at SkyNRG. This role offers a the opportunity to combine operational IT work with project-based learning in a purpose driven organisation. Your Responsibilities: IT operations support: Support day-to-day IT operations, including user onboarding and offboarding, account setup, and maintaining access across systems. First-line support: Provide first-line technical support for hardware, software, and connectivity issues. Ticketing & maintenance: Assist with ticket triage in Jira Service Management, perform device checks, and support routine system maintenance. Automation projects: Contribute to automation initiatives using the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio), helping streamline internal workflows such as user lifecycle processes. Cybersecurity support: Assist in cybersecurity initiatives, including improving incident reporting workflows and strengthening overall IT security practices. Your profile You recognize yourself in the following: • Bachelor’s or Master’s student in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field (enrolled for the full duration of the internship) • Strong interest in IT operations, automation and cybersecurity • Familiarity with at least one scripting language (Python or PowerShell preferred) • Basic understanding of JSON and API concepts is a plus • Strong problem-solving mindset with attention to detail • Good communication skills and a collaborative approach • Proactive, curious and eager to learn in a dynamic environment • Professional level of English, both written and spoken • Full-time availability for a 6-month internship starting February 15th 2027 This internship is based onsite at our office in Nieuwmarkt, Amsterdam. Due to the hands-on nature of IT operations, you will work closely with the team on-site, allowing you to handle hardware directly and benefit from close mentorship. You will have regular 1:1s with team members to support your learning and development. About SkyNRG Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality. Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel. Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions. Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards. At SkyNRG, you’ll find: An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF What we offer We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet. Besides that, we offer: A unique working experience in a scale-up at the forefront of sustainable aviation. An inspiring international work environment in a fast growing and innovative industry. A great opportunity to work in a multidisciplinary, committed, and talented team. A monthly internship allowance of 800 euros. Commuting travel reimbursement. Free Daily Lunch Paid Volunteering Day. Access to our electric company boat and social activities – all part of the deal! Is this you? Are you ready to take the next step in your career with SkyNRG? Explore our vacancies and become part of our company of change makers. Together, we can change the future of flying. For more information about SkyNRG visit www.skynrg.com. 📌 Please note: We do not accept sales inquiries or intermediary services. At SkyNRG, we deeply value inclusion and diversity. Sie vergeben und prüfen Zugriffsrechte gemäss den definierten Rollen und pflegen die Berechtigungsdaten in Abstimmung mit den zuständigen Stellen. description: Wie ben jij Jij bent een pragmatische IT‑specialist met een sterke operationele basis. Je houdt van techniek, maar krijgt vooral energie van het stabiel en voorspelbaar laten functioneren van platformen. Je schakelt makkelijk tussen techniek, operatie, regie en samenwerking. Je behoudt overzicht in complexe ketens en weet prioriteiten te stellen. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende: HBO werk‑ en denkniveau richting IT; ervaring als IT Specialist, Application Engineer of Platform Engineer; ervaring met services en (SaaS) oplossingen op Microsoft Azure; praktische kennis van Kubernetes / containers / application gateways (bij voorkeur AKS); ervaring met informatie analyse, operations, beheerprocessen en incidentafhandeling; kennis van monitoring tooling (pré: Dynatrace); ervaring met CI/CD en OTAP‑omgevingen; kennis van networking, routing, firewalls en DNS, App en Lowcode oplossingen; affiniteit met security, identity en toegangsbeheer (AD / Entra ID); ervaring met samenwerken en regie op leveranciers of MSP‑partijen; je communiceert helder, werkt gestructureerd en neemt verantwoordelijkheid. Wat ga je doen Bij Univé werken we iedere dag aan zekerheid voor onze leden. Dat doen we niet alleen met verzekeringen, maar ook met betrouwbare digitale dienstverlening. Binnen IT Kern bouwen en beheren we het fundament waarop onze dienstverlening draait. Betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid, continuïteit en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal. Het team Frontend Platform speelt hierin een cruciale rol. Wij zorgen ervoor dat onze websites, klantomgevingen en digitale contactkanalen stabiel, veilig en toekomstbestendig functioneren. Denk hierbij aan frontendplatformen, CRM‑omgevingen, monitoring, identity & access management, cloudplatformen en integraties met andere ketens. Vanwege verdere professionalisering van ons platform zoeken wij een IT Specialist Frontend Platform. Een pragmatische IT‑specialist die techniek begrijpt én overzicht houdt in de keten. De komende jaren staan onder andere een managed service partner transitie, implementatie van ons ledencontact platform, verdere standaardisatie, lifecyclemanagement, security‑verbeteringen en professionalisering van beheerprocessen centraal. Deze thema’s sluiten aan op de bredere IT Kern doelstellingen rondom stabiliteit, schaalbaarheid, monitoring, governance en professionalisering van IT‑processen. Als IT Specialist Frontend Platform zorg jij ervoor dat onze platformen stabiel, voorspelbaar en veilig functioneren. Jij bent de verbindende factor tussen techniek, operations, leveranciers en interne teams. Je bent niet alleen technisch sterk, maar begrijpt ook hoe processen, beheer, changes en samenwerking in de praktijk werken. Je overziet de gehele keten en weet verstoringen structureel op te lossen. In deze rol ligt de nadruk nadrukkelijk op continuïteit, regie, beheer en samenwerking binnen de keten. Daarbij werk je zowel hands‑on als coördinerend. Wat bieden wij Een inhoudelijk sterke rol binnen een cruciaal platform voor Univé. veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en vakinhoudelijke ontwikkeling. Nauwe samenwerking met ervaren collega’s binnen Frontend Platform. Een afwisselende rol waarin techniek, beheer en samenwerking samenkomen. De mogelijkheid om actief bij te dragen aan de verdere professionalisering van IT Kern. Hybride werken vanuit Zwolle en thuis. Overige Arbeidsvoorwaarden jaarsalaris is minimaal € 57.487 en maximaal € 81.163 op basis van een 38-urige werkweek (inclusief vakantiegeld, een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning); 13e maand en 8% vakantiegeld; variabele collectieve prestatiebeloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris; 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38‑urige werkweek; goede pensioen- en studiekostenregeling; thuiswerk- en reiskostenvergoeding; korting op schade‑ en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé. Wie wij zijn Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie. Offre d'Emploi : Lead AI Governance (Center of Expertise Data & AI Governance - Central)

Notre équipe Data & AI Governance recherche un·e Lead AI Governance (f/m/d) en CDI, basé·e à Lille ou Paris.

Chez Decathlon, nous croyons au pouvoir du sport pour unir et inspirer. Notre mission : rendre le sport accessible au plus grand nombre, partout dans le monde. Pour y parvenir, la data et l’intelligence artificielle sont au cœur de notre stratégie, guidant chaque décision, de la conception du produit à l'expérience client et sportive. Notre défi ? Déployer une IA éthique, sûre, performante et auditable à l'échelle mondiale.

Tu seras rattaché au Head of Data & AI Governance et tu rejoindras le Data & AI Governance Center of Expertise (CoE) en tant que référent·e technique et méthodologique (rôle d'expert / Staff track, sans management hiérarchique direct). Ta mission sera de bâtir et porter notre framework de gouvernance de l'IA, de sécuriser notre passage à l'échelle (Agentique, GenAI & ML classique) et de guider l'ensemble des équipes vers une IA de confiance.

TON CONTEXTE DE JEU

  • Une organisation internationale fédérée : ~70 pays et 5 Business Units majeures avec une forte autonomie locale, nécessitant un cadre clair, agile et une visibilité centrale.
  • Un produit interne dédié : La plateforme GovAI, en cours d'industrialisation (registre unique des cas d’usage, évaluation algorithmique et gestion continue des risques).
  • Un collectif pluridisciplinaire soudé : Animation d'un comité opérationnel hebdomadaire réunissant le Legal, la Compliance, les Risques, la Sécurité et les Achats.

 

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

En tant que lead d'expertise et chef d'orchestre fonctionnel, tu fais le pont entre les exigences réglementaires, la technique et le business. Tu es là pour éclairer les choix stratégiques et fédérer la communauté autour de standards responsables.

Tes missions s'articulent autour de 4 grands axes :

  • Pilotage Stratégique & Framework : Définir notre doctrine d'AI Governance (alignée sur l'AI Act / RGPD) et animer le Comité Opérationnel (Legal, Risques, Sécurité). Tu portes la roadmap globale et pilotes son succès par des KPIs concrets (ROI, délai de qualification).
  • Plateforme "GovAI" & Governance as Code : Travailler avec l'équipe Produit/Build du CoE pour industrialiser notre plateforme interne. L'objectif : implémenter une logique de Governance as Code en automatisant l'intégration des garde-fous (biais, traçabilité, drift) directement dans les pipelines (MLOps/LLMOps) pour réduire le Time to Market.
  • Gestion des Risques & Actifs IA : Standardiser la classification des risques (systèmes critiques vs non-critiques) et piloter l'inventaire unifié des modèles (GenAI & ML). Tu garantis la conformité des données (entraînement/inférence) sur tout le cycle de vie.
  • Acculturation & Réseau (AI Literacy) : Fédérer un réseau mondial (~70 pays, 5 BU) de Data Scientists, PM et leaders Tu agis en partenaire de confiance et Business Enabler pour démocratiser l'IA de confiance sans freiner l'innovation.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Expertise Senior en Gouvernance IA & Data : Une solide expérience sur les problématiques d'IA Responsable, de gestion des risques algorithmiques et de réglementation (notamment l'AI Act européen, RGPD, standards ISO/IEC 42001 ou NIST AI RMF).
  • Leadership d'influence & Posture d'expert : Excellente capacité à fédérer des collectifs pluridisciplinaires (tech, business, legal), à vulgariser des concepts complexes et à obtenir l’adhésion sans autorité hiérarchique dans un environnement international et distribué.
  • Culture Technique Data & Machine Learning : Compréhension approfondie du cycle de vie des modèles ML/DL, des architectures Cloud, des spécificités de la GenAI (RAG, fine-tuning, guardrails) et des mécanismes de données associés.
  • Esprit "Business Enabler" : Pragmatisme et sens du résultat ; tu conçois la gouvernance comme un accélérateur d'innovation sécurisé plutôt que comme un centre de contrôle bloquant.

STACK TECHNIQUE & ÉCOSYSTÈME

Dans ton quotidien, tu interagiras avec un écosystème technologique moderne :

  • Gouvernance, Métadonnées & Catalogage : Unity Catalog, Collibra, outils d'inventaire IA / Model Registry
  • Data, AI & MLOps : Databricks (Mosaic AI, MLflow), Python, dbt, Airflow, frameworks de test & monitoring IA (évaluation LLM, détection de biais/drift)


QUALIFICATIONS

  • Diplôme (Licence, Master ou École d'Ingénieur) en Informatique, Data, Systèmes d'Information ou domaine connexe.
  • 10 ans d'expérience au minimum en Data Governance, Data Stewardship, Data Quality ou gestion de programme data.
  • Expériences probante sdans l'animation de communautés et la conduite du changement.
  • Anglais courant (niveau B2/C1 minimum) dans un environnement international.

 

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Organisation de travail hybride ;
  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;
  • Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;
  • Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;
  • Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

description:
The Human Frontier Collective (HFC)’s mission is to bring the world's best minds to shape the future of AI – because the future of AI depends not only on powerful models, but on the people who teach them to think. We bring together researchers, academics, and domain leaders across 70+ fields – over 90% of members hold doctorates – to shape how frontier AI systems are built, evaluated, and governed. HFC members have since co-authored published work including SciPredict, PropensityBench, and Professional Reasoning Benchmark.

Why join the HFC

HFC centers on three core pillars: the network itself, participation in selected AI/ML projects, and opportunities to publish with our research team.

  • Join a unique and exclusive expert network: You’ll become a part of an interdisciplinary community, consisting of over 90% doctorates and field leaders representing 70+ fields from the leading institutions. We’re a collective of top innovators and thought leaders committed to advancing frontier AI to power the world’s most important decisions.

  • Co-author selected research publications: Collaborate with Scale’s research team to co-author technical reports and research papers—boosting your academic visibility and professional recognition.

  • Duration: This is a fully remote opportunity with no fixed end date; engagements continue as long as there's mutual interest. This is a 1099 independent contractor engagement.

    • Project selection: You’ll regularly get matched to carefully selected projects from our partners. Depending on the partner, projects range from evaluating AI models to designing experiments, building RL environments, co-authoring research papers, and more. 
    • Flexible schedule: There's no minimum commitment – you decide whether to take on a project. Most fellows spend 10–25 hours per week, on a schedule they set themselves.
    • Competitive pay: Project pay rates vary across platforms and depend on a number of factors, including but not limited to: projects, scope, skillset, and location. You’ll receive the pay information upon receiving project matching notifications.

Application process

  1. Apply: We review applications on a rolling basis.
  2. Interview: Candidates will get to discuss their research experience, professional background, and alignment with our mission to advance human-centered AI. Note: If we invited you directly, your invitation will say whether this step applies.

  • Contributes actively to Agile ceremonies, and raises when one is no longer useful.

CULTURE

  • Documents solutions to a level the next person can use: diagrams, decisions and reasoning.

LEADERSHIP

  • Treats input from design, product and QA as a constraint to understand rather than an obstacle.

  • Experience working in an established codebase alongside other engineers.

 Desirable:

description:
Who We Are

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore. 

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

Our Commerce & Technology division helps leading global brands design, build and run the commerce platforms behind their growth. We are seeking a Principal Solutions Architect to lead solution in business pursuits and account growth, across enterprise commerce. 

You will be the person in the room who understands how the whole commerce estate fits together, from web storefront and mobile app through commerce platform, data and ERP.   You will turn that understanding into a clear case for business value, win the trust of senior client stakeholders, and when it helps, build a working demonstration to show them what good looks like. 
 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Architect Enterprise Commerce: Design end to end commerce solutions across Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopify, HCL and composable (MACH) solutions, spanning web, mobile apps, data and back office systems.  
  • Lead with value: Frame every solution around commercial outcomes, cost and return, so clients can see clear cases for change rather than a technology shopping list.  
  • Serve as an outward-facing, energetic leader who runs workshops, participates in governance, and collaborates with commercial teams to identify and shape technical growth opportunities. 

What you’ll be doing 

  • Client Engagement and Discovery: Build trusted relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders. Run discovery workshops, ask the questions that uncover what really matters, and cut through complexity to the decisions that count. 
  • Solution Design and Architecture: Produce clear architecture diagrams and solution designs covering storefront, mobile apps, commerce platform, search, content, order management, product information, payments, data and other integrations. Recommend the right platform and approach for each client rather than defaulting to one. 
  • Platform Selection and Replatforming: Guide clients through platform choices and migrations, including the move from monolithic to composable, weighing total cost of ownership, speed to market, risk and operating model. 
  • Data, Integration and Back Office: Get into the detail of how commerce connects to ERP (such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Oracle), order management, warehouse, customer data and analytics, and design integration patterns that hold up at enterprise scale. 
  • Mobile and Omnichannel: Shape mobile app strategy and architecture (native, cross platform and headless) alongside web, store and marketplace channels, so the customer experience is joined up. 
  • Business Case and Value: Build business cases, value models and roadmaps that link technology decisions to revenue, conversion, margin and cost to serve. 
  • Demonstrations and Proofs of Concept: Stand up demo storefronts and prototypes quickly, such as a Shopify store or a composable proof of concept, to show clients what is possible and take risk out of their decisions. 
  • Proposals and Pitches: Own the solution story, architecture, assumptions and effort estimates in proposals, and present them with confidence at pitch. 
  • Handover and Delivery Assurance: Make sure what is sold can be delivered, with a clean handover to delivery teams and continued involvement through mobilisation. 
  • Market and Partner Leadership: Stay across the commerce market, including cloud (AWS, GCP), AI in commerce and agentic commerce. Share that knowledge to strengthen our propositions and our partner relationships. 

What we want from you 

  • Enterprise Commerce Experience: Extensive senior experience in enterprise commerce across retail, consumer brands or B2B, gained in digital agencies, consultancies or large brands. 
  • Breadth Across Platforms: Strong working knowledge of Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Shopify, plus composable and MACH (microservices, API first, cloud native, headless) components such as Commerce tools, Contentful, Algolia, Akeneo or similar. 
  • Presales and New Business: A track record of shaping and winning significant commerce deals, running workshops, writing proposals and presenting to senior audiences. 
  • Commercial Acumen: Understands how clients make money. Speaks confidently about value, cost and return, and can hold a commercial conversation with a Chief Executive or Chief Financial Officer as easily as with a Chief Technology Officer. 
  • Data and ERP Integration: Hands on understanding of how commerce connects with ERP, order management, product information, customer data and analytics, and the integration patterns that make it work. 
  • Mobile Apps: Solid understanding of mobile commerce app architecture and delivery, including native and cross platform approaches and how apps connect to headless commerce services. 
  • Architecture and Communication: Excellent diagramming, written and verbal skills. Able to turn complex estates into simple pictures and clear stories for senior audiences. 
  • Hands On Credibility: Comfortable building a demo store, configuring a platform or proving a concept yourself, rather than relying on slides alone. 
  • Presence: Energetic, confident and credible with clients. Able to cut through noise and lead the room. 

If you know some of this, even better 

  • Certifications across Adobe Commerce, Salesforce B2C Commerce or Shopify, MACH 
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate or Professional) and experience running commerce on Cloud solutions.  
  • Order management, product information management and marketplace platforms 
  • B2B commerce, including complex pricing, catalogue and account structures 
  • Agentic commerce concepts and emerging standards (ACP, AP2, A2A) and practical use of AI in commerce 
  • Total cost of ownership and business case modelling 
  • The C4 model and diagrams as code 

What we can offer you

Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.

Permanent only
We offer a great benefits package including a discretionary bonus scheme, training opportunities, competitive pension, medical insurance, life assurance, social events, opportunities to buy and sell holidays, family friendly policies, discounts with hundreds of retailers and much more.

Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.

We lead with Heart, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.
We empower your Brains for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.
And we champion Courage, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.

 

How we use AI in the recruitment process: 
 
To ensure more focused and engaging conversations, we leverage AI in our recruitment process exclusively for secure, objective note-taking, never for evaluative judgments. This allows our team to be fully present with you. You are always welcome to request a transcript of these notes or opt out of this feature at any time. Opting out will not impact  the outcome of the interview process"

description:
Cato Networks is the converged network and security cloud for the AI era. 

As AI reshapes cybersecurity, enterprises face a dual challenge: unlocking AI’s potential while defending against AI-driven attacks. Cato addresses both through a unified, cloud-native platform, providing the visibility and context to prioritize risks and stop threats in real time across users, applications, data, and AI agents. 

Join us as we scale: take on ambitious technological challenges and shape the next generation of enterprise security at a company trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide. 

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

Cato Networks is building Product-Led Growth capabilities that complement its established enterprise, direct-sales, and partner-led business.

We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager to own product-led customer journeys across Cato’s target markets, with a particular focus on SMB while also improving how larger enterprise customers discover, evaluate, activate, adopt, and expand Cato.

For SMB customers, this may include highly self-service journeys from signup and onboarding through value realization, purchase, and expansion. For larger enterprises, PLG will complement the sales-led motion by helping customers experience value sooner, adopt more effectively, identify expansion opportunities, and create stronger product-qualified demand.

This is an individual-contributor role. You will own measurable customer and business outcomes, working directly with Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Sales, Channel, Customer Success, and Business Operations.

What You’ll Do 

  • Own and improve the end-to-end PLG journey across relevant customer segments: discover → evaluate → activate → experience value → adopt → convert → retain → expand.
  • Define segment-specific product-led journeys for SMB and enterprise customers, balancing self-service, sales-assisted, and partner-assisted experiences.
  • For SMB, drive simple self-service onboarding, guided configuration, sensible defaults, in-product education, packaging, upgrade paths, and purchase experiences.
  • For enterprise customers, identify ways to accelerate evaluation, activation, time-to-value, adoption, product-qualified demand, and expansion.
  • Define the key activation and “aha” moments for different customer segments, and improve time-to-first-value and unassisted or assisted activation.
  • Own product requirements related to trials, free experiences where relevant, packaging, entitlements, upgrade paths, pricing UX, purchase flows, and conversion triggers.
  • Define, instrument, and monitor PLG metrics, including activation, time-to-first-value, product adoption, conversion, product-qualified opportunities, retention, and expansion.
  • Use product analytics, customer research, funnel analysis, and experimentation to identify friction, test hypotheses, and continuously improve outcomes.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Channel, Customer Success, Finance, and Business Operations to create seamless product-led, sales-assisted, and partner-assisted journeys.
  • Identify product-usage and behavioral signals that can trigger contextual recommendations, expansion opportunities, partner engagement, or sales outreach. 

What You Bring 

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS. 
  • Deep understanding of Product-Led Growth, including SaaS metrics, freemium and trial models, and PLG-driven customer journeys. 
  • Strong experience defining and delivering user-facing product experiences, with a solid understanding of UI/UX principles. 
  • Background or strong familiarity with networking and security technologies is an Advantage . 
  • Understanding of the SMB networking and security market, including customer needs and the services these customers typically purchase. 
  • Strong leadership and communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.

Low ego, high bias for action, and comfort in ambiguity — equally at home crafting a strategy narrative and diving into metrics, a UX detail, or a customer escalation.
